text.text:
There is a picture of a cargo plane taking off with happy people waving from the windows.  "The north is cold.

Our love is true

I hope to see you

In Croatan

My dearest, please join me.  I don't believe there are many flights left before people will be stuck here forever."

A person wrapped up in bandages in a hospital bed is pictured on the front of this card.  "Get well soon!!!

Torrance, I'm sorry you feel ill but so many new hires forget to treat the wild lichen before they eat it."
A picture of a bloody steak.  This card appears particularly old.  "Gauchos Steaks.  Deliveries made monthly from Brazil to New England.  Sign up today!"

A glossy image of flowers and funeral statuary.  "I'm sorry for your loss.  Ebby was an excellent grandparent and we hate for you that he was infected with the Moxphoria and wandered into the wastes."

An aerial view of a snowbound town.  "Happy Founders' Day!

Leonid,

This place is cold as Hell but we've made a life out here in the last ten years."

An old style movie theater.  "Showing the vintage film Aelita!

 Tovarishch,

 Come with me to the movies.  My grandfather says that this movie is one of the classics."
